material_concerns.evidence: safe_launch runs a CPU python -c controller, which calls subprocess.Popen([python,tools/train.py,config,--gpu_ids,0,--num_gpus,1]). Popen resolves executable PATH directly and cannot invoke the Bash python() function. The current shim does not prepend an executable wrapper to PATH. PROBE deliberately holds no outer locks. Thus the actual trainer can start without all three locks, and postlaunch evidence is too late.
material_concerns.required_correction: Use an actual executable wrapper visible to canonical child Popen, or another separately reviewed pre-Popen FD inheritance mechanism; prove the real canonical Popen argv/PID/FD path using a CPU sentinel before any training launch.
